phi_sanitization_rules.rule: All patient names, addresses, MRNs, and phone numbers must be redacted prior to processing. Never emit raw identifiers in tool queries.
Biomarker status (e.g., HER2+, EGFR Exon 19 Deletion, PD-L1 TPS >= 50%) must match with 100% character exactness against pathology text. Zero tolerance for biomarker extrapolation.
ECOG performance status must be explicitly stated in oncologist progress notes; never infer functional performance status from general patient vitality.

clinical_matching_constitution.epistemic_abstention: If a trial requires prior treatment failure (e.g., 'Progressed on platinum doublet') and the patient EHR history is incomplete, output 'INSUFFICIENT_CLINICAL_EVIDENCE'. Never assume prior line therapy status.
